description: Goo Shield default look, PIXEL-SAMPLED from design/reference/goo_shield-character-sheet.png (service venv PIL, 5x5 medians): the six palette chips (intake.json swatches: pale 242,253,223 / mid 210,246,160 / bright 147,250,11 / near-black 38,38,37 / highlight 86,86,84 / grey-green 133,140,124) plus direct samples of the drawn surfaces (front view unless noted). NO GLOW: the bright lime is paint, not emission (brief). The goo is translucent: its regions carry 'alpha' (Col alpha = glTF COLOR_0.a; the goo material is alphaMode BLEND, single-sided, glossy: material.goo_roughness); material.alpha multiplies every translucent region. Rock + eyes are opaque (material.roughness). Chip 133,140,124 is the sheet's thin light rim LINE along the rock edges (line art, 1.3-1.7 % of the rock pixels, lum 100-160): not a surface tone, unused.
